1.  **Holmore Works**: Quote 190 (Too high).
2.  **Orlnick Outfitters**: Quote 105 (Pass), Delivery 5 days (Pass), Rating 2 (Fail, needs >= 7).
3.  **Pellbury Supply**: Quote 60 (Pass), Delivery 3 days (Pass), Rating 1 (Fail, needs >= 7).
4.  **Ulmbury Traders**: Quote 75 (Pass), Delivery 18 days (Fail, needs <= 10).
5.  **Caldale Supply**: Quote 60 (Pass), Delivery 3 days (Pass), Rating 4 (Fail, needs >= 7).
6.  **Garcroft Supply**: Quote 190 (Too high).
7.  **Jormere Outfitters**: Quote 125 (Pass, <= 145), Delivery 3 days (Pass, <= 10), Rating 8 (Pass, >= 7).

The only supplier meeting all criteria is Jormere Outfitters.
